title: yadakchi.offers.fitted.v1
description:
Which vehicles one offer fits, tri-state, with the evidence behind each verdict.

Producers: fitment. Consumers: matcher, catalog.
Kafka message key: offer_uid — it must be set; compaction and partition ordering depend on it.
Cleanup: delete, retention 90 days.

This file validates a whole Kafka message body: the shared envelope from docs/specs/02-EVENT-CONTRACTS.md plus this topic's payload. Unknown fields are ignored, never rejected, at both levels — that is what lets a producer add an optional field without breaking a consumer.

event_id.description: UUIDv4, unique per emission. Two emissions of the same fact carry different event_ids; consumers deduplicate on the payload's natural identity, not on this.

event_type.description: The topic name without the 'yadakchi.' prefix and without the version suffix.

version.description: Envelope and payload version. A removed field, a renamed field or a changed type is a breaking change: publish to .v2 and run both until consumers migrate.

occurred_at.description: When the fact happened, ISO-8601 UTC with Z. Consumers tolerate out-of-order delivery across partitions by comparing this, never by assuming global ordering.

producer.description: The service that emitted this message. Constrained to the producers declared for this topic in platform/kafka/topics.yml.

trace_id.description: Propagated across the whole chain for debugging. Minted by crawler on yadakchi.listings.observed.v1 and carried through every derived event; a service starting a chain of its own (a human admin edit, a scheduled recomputation) mints a fresh one. Every service logs it.

payload.description: Fitment is tri-state and is never collapsed to a boolean: downstream, unknown means 'show with a caveat', not 'incompatible'. This topic is not compacted, so payload is never null; there is no tombstone on a delete-retention topic.

offer_uid.description: The offer these verdicts belong to.

fitments.description: One entry per vehicle this offer was evaluated against. An empty array means nothing could be evaluated yet.

vehicle_slug.description: The vehicle this verdict is about.

evidence.description: What the verdict rests on: agreeing seller count, the offers and hints behind it, the rule that fired.

crossref_codes.description: Equivalent part numbers found for this offer. A display hint, never an identity claim — matcher must not merge across brands because of one.

risky_family.description: Set when the offer's part type needs finer granularity than model plus trim (headlights need a year, head gaskets need an engine code) and that granularity is absent. null otherwise.

part_type.description: The controlled-vocabulary key of the risky family.

required_granularity.description: What is missing, e.g. "year" or "engine". Drives the warning downstream.

note_fa.description: The Persian warning shown to the user on the product page.
